`SiteFooter` is defined in `web/src/components/site-footer.tsx`. I searched the whole repo, excluding `node_modules`, `.git` and `.next`. Nine files import and render it, and none of them is a test file. No test file references it.

- `web/src/app/page.tsx` (uses `variant="landing"`)
- `web/src/app/verify/email/verify-page-shell.tsx`
- `web/src/app/tuna/page.tsx`
- `web/src/app/communities/page.tsx`
- `web/src/app/communities/new/page.tsx`
- `web/src/app/user/[handle]/page.tsx`
- `web/src/app/community/[slug]/page.tsx`
- `web/src/app/community/[slug]/not-found.tsx`
- `web/src/app/claim/page.tsx` (renders it twice)
